applications.terms: 12 weeks, full-time, paid $800/week. Must be in the New York area the whole time.
applications.subject: Design Intern / Environments – Dylan Riegert
notes: No deadline is posted, so it's likely rolling. Earlier is better.
The written instructions say internships@2x4.org; the Apply button opens jobinquiries@2x4.org. Send to internships@2x4.org.
Georgie Stout, who visited Pro Practices on Oct 6, is a 2x4 co-founder. Mention the visit in your letter.
Environments sits between graphic design, architecture and experience design. Show at least one project applied in a space.

steps.title: Confirm you can be in NYC for 12 weeks full-time, and pick the term
Study 2x4 Environments projects; note 2–3 you'd reference
Update your CV and export it as a PDF
Pick 6–8 projects for the portfolio, systems work first
Mock up one project in a physical space (signage, exhibit wall, storefront)
Lay out the portfolio PDF and get it under 10 MB
Write the letter of interest and export it as a PDF
Final check (file names, subject line), then send
Follow up if you haven't heard back
